notes:
Background: Cerulean is a mid-market productivity SaaS (knowledge base + customer support automation). Evaluating Redwood as primary inference vendor for search + relevance. Team is product-led; switching from hybrid Elastic + in-house rerank layer to hosted LLM reranking for better freshness and intent capture.

Key points from calls: • 2025-11-18 demo (Ethan/Jordan + Cerulean PMs) — liked streaming and function calling; asked about token costs at scale. • 2025-11-25 scoping call with Engineering (notes in Drive). • Security review started 2025-12-01; they require SSO + audit logs + KMS and want data residency options for EU customers.

Quotes: "We need rerank scores that map back to offline evals — reproducible scoring is a must" (Head of Search).

Commercials: initial interest in Hosted API to speed time-to-value, then transition to Dedicated for predictable latency and cost. Price sensitivity around per-token vs committed GPU pool. Finance requested a 3-tier pricing worksheet.

POC Ask: 2-week experiment to compare current Elastic-first rank -> in-house reranker vs Redwood hosted rerank endpoint. Goals: (1) offline scoring parity on curated eval set, (2) live A/B click-lift >= 6% on support search, (3) tail latency p95 < 350ms for 512-token contexts when routed to Dedicated.

Integration notes: existing infra is AWS-heavy; prefer VPC peering for Dedicated. Engineering asks for simple SDK examples and a Python sample to run offline batch scoring over CSV eval set.

Internal: follow-ups assigned — Jordan to own POC plan, Ethan to provide pricing worksheet, Priya to prepare onboarding & CSM readiness if ARR > $100k.

Status: moving to POC; security questionnaire is main gating item.

use_case_summary: Primary: reranking for product and support search (improve click-through and task completion). Workload: mix of synchronous request/response for product search and high-throughput offline scoring for evaluation. Targets: p95 latency < 350ms on 512-token contexts for Dedicated, throughput ~200 reqs/sec during peak, cost-sensitive (looking to reduce per-ticket inference cost vs in-house costs). Prefer ability to pin model versions, run offline scoring reproducibly, and get per-request debug traces to map to eval labels.
poc_scope: Two-week POC: 1) ingest curated eval set (drive:/scoring/cerulean-eval-set-v1.csv) and run offline rerank scoring via Redwood batch APIs; 2) instrument A/B on support search for 10% of traffic for live click-lift measurement; 3) confirm integration with their SSO + KMS for secrets; 4) capture token cost and latency breakdown for Hosted vs Dedicated runs.
